segments.he:
תּוֹרָה עה
הִסְתַּכְּלוּת פְּנֵי הַצַּדִּיקִים לְבַד הוּא דָּבָר גָּדוֹל מְאֹד, בְּוַדַּאי כְּשֶׁזּוֹכִים לְדַבֵּר עִמּוֹ טוֹב יוֹתֵר אַךְ גַּם הַהִסְתַּכְּלוּת לְבַד הוּא טוֹב מְאֹד וּמוֹעִיל לַקְּדֻשָּׁה מְאֹד:
segments.en: Even one who is a wanderer — and comes sometimes to places very far from the service of Hashem Yisborach — such as in the houses of the wicked and even in the houses of non-Jews — even so there is power in Israel to elevate and raise all these places to Hashem Yisborach. Therefore one must do one's part — to draw oneself to Hashem Yisborach with everything one is able — in every place one is.
